description: Traffic Signal LiDAR-derived Vehicle Trajectories Dataset is a data set deposited in Purdue University Research Repository by its authors Taylor Li, Mark Taylor (University of Texas at Arlington). p This dataset provides the estimated location of vehicle trajectories sampled from LiDAR sensors at the intersection of US-89 and 600 N (latitude: 40.782395, longitude: -111.899691) in Salt Lake City, Utah, from 15:49:25 to 17:14:00 hrs. (MT) on December 30, 2022. /p p All four corners of the intersection were equipped with LiDAR sensors. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. Formats: CSV. Size stated: 1 file. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
